acceptanceBoundary: isolated TEST_ONLY qualification; not E1 completion

inputs.registration: All numerical inputs and acceptance rules were fixed before the first dynamics run; do not tune tolerances from measured output.
inputs.coordinates: right-handed; X/Y horizontal; Z up; SI metres, kilograms, seconds, radians

oracle.position: p0 + v0*t + gravity*t*t/2; compare full displacement vector, scale=norm(gravity)*t*t/2
oracle.velocity: v0 + gravity*t; compare full velocity vector, scale=norm(gravity)*t
oracle.convergence: For each mass/repeat: coarse/refined displacement distance <= max(0.0001 m, 0.01*analytic displacement); refined displacement L2 error must not exceed coarse L2 error. Velocity remains within its analytical tolerance in both regimes.
oracle.massIndependence: At each time, substep regime and repeat, compare all masses using the same analytical displacement/velocity tolerance, never a scale taken from measured output.
oracle.repeatability: All raw samples for repeated identical worlds must match exactly at the same timestep.
oracle.roundoff: Engine uses float32. No rounding of states. Readback mass relative tolerance 1e-6 only checks configuration representation.

inputs.rationale: Nominal 5 ms macrostep / 4 substeps is the initial candidate from REQ-PHY-04; repeat with 8 substeps to halve dt. No FPS or wall-clock input. Three complete repetitions, deterministic construction order, no RNG/noise (seed 0). Contact-free window ends at 0.4 s; floor collider verifies separation. Collider owns the entire mass; rigid body additional mass remains zero.
